themes.name: Ruffians of the Shire
themes.pitch: Halfling and Rogue lackeys sneak through the Shire while Lotho counts the take.

themes.name: Bleeding for Bag End
themes.pitch: Lotho's life loss becomes a price you gladly pay, topped up by drain and lifegain.

themes.name: Scouring of the Shire
themes.pitch: Ruffians march in, die in droves, and every death pays out in blood and gold.

themes.name: Shirriff's Rules and Regulations
themes.pitch: Lock down opponents with taxes, tapping and restrictions, funded by all that Treasure.

themes.name: Fields of Fury
themes.pitch: Ramp, fetch and play lands every turn, and watch a stampede of 5/5 Elementals pile up.

themes.name: Elemental Stampede
themes.pitch: Fill the board with hulking tokens and reward the whole go-wide army with anthems and mass pump.

themes.name: Rage Made Manifest
themes.pitch: Every Elemental that dies lashes out with 3 damage, so chump blocks and sacrifices become fireworks.

themes.name: Pillars of the Locus
themes.pitch: Big blinkable ETB creatures re-trigger over and over while Omnath's tokens guard the fort.

themes.name: Titans of the Wild
themes.pitch: Omnath's 5/5s are just the start: stack huge trampling beasts and dinosaurs and crush opponents with raw power.

themes.name: Buried Treasure Boom
themes.pitch: Loot the earth for Treasures, then sacrifice them and your fodder as free-flowing mana and value pile up.

themes.name: One Vastness of Rippling Leaves
themes.pitch: Every land drop draws a card, and ramp and fetch effects keep the landfall triggers flowing.

themes.name: Tides of Yavimaya
themes.pitch: Lead a Merfolk tribe out of the shallows, with Tatyova's landfall keeping you stocked with cards and life.

themes.name: One Deepness of Life
themes.pitch: Gain life with every land and every trigger, then turn the surplus into cards and value.

themes.name: Roots Deeper Than Death
themes.pitch: Fill the graveyard, then replay lands from it so every drop triggers Tatyova again.

themes.name: One Chatter of Animals
themes.pitch: Each land calls a beast, insect or elemental to your side, and the board swells while you draw.

themes.name: Circle of the Druids
themes.pitch: Fill the board with mana-making druids and elves, then dump the extra mana into big turns of land drops.

themes.name: Two Voices, One Spell
themes.pitch: Cast cheap spells and watch every magecraft and prowess trigger fire twice, snowballing into huge value.

themes.name: Efreet Spellstorm
themes.pitch: Chain rituals and cantrips in one blazing turn, pumping Veyran while triggers double all the way down.

themes.name: Echo Chamber Wizardry
themes.pitch: Copy your best instants and sorceries, then let Veyran turn each copy into two rounds of triggers.

themes.name: Prismari Faculty Mixer
themes.pitch: A Wizard-filled college faculty of blue-red mages, each doubling up magecraft and casting triggers on cue.

themes.name: Twice-Told Treasure Hoard
themes.pitch: Turn each spell into an engine: double triggers make Treasures, Clues, and tokens pour out as you cast.

themes.name: Borrowed Wishes Djinn
themes.pitch: Exile and cast opponents' and your own spells, then copy them so Veyran doubles the payoff.

themes.name: Chronicles of the Sleepless
themes.pitch: Cast legend after legend, drawing a card each time while paying a little life for the privilege.

themes.name: Scourge Without Mercy
themes.pitch: Your legends all gain menace, so they slip past blockers and punish opponents who connect with them.

themes.name: Order of the Sleepless Knights
themes.pitch: Humans and Knights march together in armor, with a cast of legendary captains leading the charge.

themes.name: Blood-Price Bookkeepers
themes.pitch: Life is currency: bleed for cards, then gain it back and drain the table dry.

themes.name: Armory of Legends
themes.pitch: Legendary equipment and artifacts arm your menacing legends, drawing cards as each relic enters play.

themes.name: Legends Never Sleep
themes.pitch: Legendary creatures die gloriously, then return from the graveyard to draw even more cards.

themes.name: Every Hallway Bleeds
themes.pitch: Ping, drain and drip life loss on every opponent's turn so Valgavoth grows and draws each time.

themes.name: Harrower Ascendant
themes.pitch: Stack counters on a flying, ward-protected Elder Demon until it ends the table in the air.

themes.name: Infernal Court of Duskmourn
themes.pitch: Fill the house with Demons, big and flying, and let the Harrower rule them.

themes.name: Soul Tithe Banquet
themes.pitch: Spend your own life like currency for cards and power, and let ward make rivals pay theirs.

themes.name: House of Cage Matches
themes.pitch: Goad the table into brawling each other, so every bloody fight feeds Valgavoth on their turn.

themes.name: Feed the House
themes.pitch: Sacrifice a stream of expendable bodies and drain the table with every death.

themes.name: The Unsinkable Fleet
themes.pitch: Your artifacts are hexproof and indestructible, so you build a fortress of metal that opponents can't touch.

themes.name: Charge the Engines
themes.pitch: Stack charge counters on Spacecraft and artifacts, then cash in the buildup for big payoffs.

themes.name: Station Crew Roll Call
themes.pitch: Tap big bodies to power up the flagship, and keep a crew of heavy hitters at the ready.

themes.name: Armory of the Inspirit
themes.pitch: Every counter-boosted artifact you own is a weapon, and the equipped creatures wielding them hit hard.

themes.name: Thopter Swarm Launch
themes.pitch: Pump out artifact creature tokens, then grow the whole squadron with counters and anthems.

themes.name: Ghost in the Machine
themes.pitch: Blink and clone your artifact value creatures, with indestructibility keeping the engine running all game.

name: Omo, Queen of Vesuva

themes.name: Court of a Thousand Faces
themes.pitch: Omo is every creature type at once, so every lord, changeling and tribal payoff you own works for her.

themes.name: Every Shore of Vesuva
themes.pitch: Every marked land becomes every land type, rewarding your land drops, fetches and type-hungry lands.

themes.name: The Queen's Procession
themes.pitch: Swing with Omo every turn, stacking everything counters and triggering every attack payoff as the court marches.

themes.name: Coronation Encore
themes.pitch: Flicker and clone Omo to re-crown new lands and creatures again and again, with value ETBs along the way.

themes.name: Everything Counts
themes.pitch: Everything counters are counters too: proliferate them, double them, and grow a board of modified creatures.

themes.name: A Crowd of Every Kind
themes.pitch: Flood the board with tokens and let Omo's all-types blessing turn every anthem and tribal lord into a mass pump.
